Would one of you guys please call me.
(phone hidden)

My brother and I have managed to get the Thor P2 up and running.
We have been trying different avenues.

We are currently at 9min runtime.

Would like to discuss this with you.

James M.
Handed to the team · Customer asked to be called about a repeating Thor P2 restart/runtime fault; nee

Hi James,

I've passed your number to JD, who handles the Thor hardware. The team is offline this evening, so he'll pick it up tomorrow from 10am ET and you'll hear back by phone or email.

In the meantime, dropping out after about nine minutes usually points at firmware or power. Check the version the unit shows against the latest for the Thor P2 on https://harlolabs.com/ and update if you're behind, and make sure it's on its own supply, not shared.

If you'd rather get it sorted tonight, JD is active on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post there and mention @nullhashrate.

Thanks for your patience,
Sarah
